# Dataset cards

No real evaluation dataset is committed to this repository, and none was available in the build environment. The only dataset AEGIS creates on its own is the synthetic one described below. Register real datasets through the Benchmark Laboratory, which requires provenance, a licence and a consent or lawful basis, and document each one with the template.

## `aegis-reference-watermark-synthetic` (generated by `make benchmark`)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | Synthetic. Results are labelled **simulated**. |
| Generator | `SyntheticLM` (first-order Markov model, Zipf profile with exponent 1.0) over the AEGIS pseudo-word vocabulary |
| Size | 240 base samples (120 watermarked, 120 not); validation 60, test 180 originals plus 360 transformed test variants |
| Lengths | 20, 40, 80 or 160 tokens (`group = length_N`) |
| Transforms | `token_replacement_20pct`, `token_replacement_40pct` (uniform random) |
| Key | Fresh random 32-byte key per generation. Never stored; only its fingerprint goes in the run configuration. |
| Licence | CC0-1.0 (contains no human-authored content) |
| Personal data | None |
| Suitable for | Exercising the verification pipeline, length effects and replacement robustness of the reference scheme |
| Not suitable for | Any claim about real generators, real text or deployment performance |

## Template for registered datasets

| Field | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Name / version | |
| Provenance | How it was collected, by whom and when; generator models and prompts for AI samples |
| Licence and terms | |
| Consent / lawful basis | For human-written samples |
| Personal data | Present? Minimisation and redaction applied |
| Composition | Domains, languages, generators, lengths, label balance |
| Splits | How train/validation/test were formed; what is held out (generator, domain or language) |
| Subgroup fields | Only fields collected with consent; how small groups are handled |
| Transformations | Documented, reproducible procedures |
| Known gaps and biases | |
| SHA-256 | Recorded automatically at registration |
